name: Opacity fade
summary: An animated opacity ramp, most often a fade to black closing a held beat.
qualityChecks: the ramp lands exactly on the intended frame
no visible banding across the fade
the fade does not start before its motivating beat
failureModes: a fade so short it reads as a cut

riskGates.basis: Admitted opacity keyframes are shared by preview and emitter.

safetyGates.basis: Exact opacity channels are revalidated at admission.

provenance.claim: Final Cut supports fades as a native operation
an animated adjust-blend amount keyframe edited from 0 to 25% returned as 0.25

validation.notes: The former Living Still v1 opacity route was retired. This remains craft guidance until a dedicated fade effect owns the admitted native construction.

refusalConditions: Do not apply when the stated prerequisite is not met.
safety: Review the result on representative media before use.
